title: Restoring Hover on Touchscreens Using a Mouse Pointer

contributions.purpose: 在触屏上复原桌面式hover两阶段交互
contributions.mechanism: tablet mouse pointer:单指拖动控制虚拟指针触发hover,再点选,无需额外硬件;HTML/JS原型
contributions.source_quote: we introduce the tablet mouse pointer, a novel technique that restores two-phase interaction: hover followed by tap

contributions.purpose: 提供任务与标准化评测设计
contributions.mechanism: 动态星级评分任务+NASA-TLX工作负荷+SUS可用性,三方法反平衡
contributions.source_quote: Presents a web-based prototype and study design that combine a dynamic star-rating task with standardized workload (NASA-TLX) and usability (SUS) measures

contributions.purpose: 证明指针降低误选与遮挡
contributions.evaluation: Overshoot:Pointer 0.03 vs Touch 0.08,Attempts 1.04 vs 1.12;但tCorrect更慢(1979ms vs 1445ms)
contributions.source_quote: Provides empirical evidence that the tablet pointer reduces selection errors and finger occlusion while approaching mouse-level precision

self_declared_provenance.quote: few studies attempt to directly replicate the desktop pointer and hover paradigm on mobile devices using only standard touch input. Existing alternatives generally rely on proximity sensing, external hardware, or gesture surrogates. Our work addresses this gap

notes: 有明确3条贡献列表。负结果/trade-off:pointer可用性SUS更低(67.50 vs touch 83),完成时间更慢(tCorrect 1979ms vs 1445ms),偏好3人选touch/2人选pointer;换来更低误选(overshoot 0.03 vs 0.08)。数据红旗:NASA-TLX表n=5但报95%CI且CI普遍大于均值(如Mental 42.00±51.50、Frustration 24.00±53.12),Pointer performance 100.00±0.00,统计力极弱、误差条几乎无意义;反平衡分配2人vs3人不均且描述含笔误(pointer/touch顺序标注混乱)。checklist AI披露:多为[B]主人类AI辅助(实现由AI、执行由研究者)。
